name: Marie Callender's Chicken Pot Pie (Heavy Saturated Fat & Flaky Crust Warning)
whyItWorks: A single 15-oz pie delivers 50g+ of fat (including 18g saturated fat from lard/shortening) and hundreds of whole green peas with tough insoluble skins. The massive lipid volume triggers rapid biliary dumping, nausea, and loose stools.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Fat Trigger Warning: Avoid commercial frozen pot pies during flares. If in deep remission, eat half a pie and leave the whole green pea skins.
watchOuts: Extreme fat load (50g+) and insoluble pea skins provoke acute cramping and diarrhea.
